entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: The infant son of Adam Carthalion, marked with the sigil of the new moon, who grows up a street urchin in Arathoxia and becomes the Shadow Mage.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's father, a lord who dies fighting Ravidel and is later revealed to have murdered his wife for power.

entities.name: Gwendolyn Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's mother, murdered by Adam.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A powerful battlemage planeswalker who arrives in a flying barge and conquers Arathoxia from Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Adam's spellsquire who raises Jared and dies in the fall of Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Liana
entities.description: A shapeshifting planeswalker bound by an oath to the Scarlet Vizier who helps Jared against Ravidel.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: The ruler of the Carthalion estate who rebuffs Ezer and dies telling Jared the truth about his mother.

entities.name: Eusomoné
entities.description: A Hurloon Minotaur Jared summons who gives him the sword Foecleaver.

entities.name: Yorgo
entities.description: A street urchin leader who becomes Jared's ally.

entities.name: Nikko
entities.description: One of Yorgo's ruffians who joins Jared and is killed by Narok.

entities.name: Narok
entities.description: Ravidel's orcish man-at-arms who kills Nikko.

entities.name: Lady Verdenth
entities.description: The mistress of Krysalthus Forest, killed by Ravidel.

entities.name: Bikov
entities.description: The blue lord of the western isles, annihilated by Ravidel's Chaos Orb.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: The city-state on Stonehaven's southwestern coast conquered by Ravidel.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: The castle where Ravidel resides and which is destroyed.

entities.name: Ephren
entities.description: The plains where Adam Carthalion fought Ravidel.

entities.name: Shivan Dragon
entities.description: A dragon Jared summons that tears down Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Black Lotus
entities.description: An artifact stolen from the Scarlet estate by Jared and crushed to summon the dragon.

entities.name: Rhuell
entities.description: Ravidel's long-lost Chromium friend, whom he thinks the Shivan Dragon is.

entities.name: Foecleaver
entities.description: Adam Carthalion's sword, gifted to Jared by Eusomoné.

events.summary: Adam Carthalion is defeated by Ravidel at Ephren, entrusts his spelltrove and infant Jared to Ezer, and obliterates Ravidel's barge and himself with Inferno.
events.quote: He then casts an Inferno spell, obliterating Ravidel's barge and himself along with it.

events.summary: A treefolk defends the sleeping infant Jared from wolves in the forest of Krisylthas.
events.quote: the tree they are resting against is a treefolk

events.summary: The Scarlet Vizier rebuffs Ezer at the Carthalion estate while Liana, disguised as a child, watches.
events.quote: is rebuffed by the Scarlet Vizier , who calls him a liar and throws him and the infant into the street

events.summary: Seven years later Jared disintegrates a berserker sent by Ravidel with a scroll from his father's spelltrove, and Ezer names him the Shadow Mage.
events.quote: Ezer joyfully notes that Jared now has access to red magic, and names the child The Shadow Mage .

events.summary: At fifteen Jared summons a minotaur and kills a giant spider, and the minotaur gifts him Foecleaver.
events.quote: he gifts Jared his sword Foecleaver

events.summary: Jared steals the Black Lotus, learns of his mother, and with Liana escapes the baths; Ravidel beats Jared back until Liana reveals three Moxes and Ravidel leaves.
events.quote: Liana reveals she has three Moxes , giving her the upper hand in a duel.

events.summary: Ravidel attacks Arathoxia with juggernauts and a Chaos Orb that annihilates Bikov and the port; the Scarlet Vizier dies telling Jared his mother was murdered and frees Liana; Ravidel kills Verdenth.
events.quote: With his last breath, the vizier releases Liana from his indentured servitude.

events.summary: Jared swears vengeance on Ravidel for the murder of his parents.
events.quote: Jared swears vengeance against Ravidel for the murder of his parents.

events.summary: Yorgo brings the captured sultan to Jared and hands him a fellwar stone and scroll to enter Castle Melmereth.
events.quote: Yorgo hands Jared a fellwar stone and a spell scroll he can use to enter Castle Melmereth

events.summary: In Castle Melmereth Ravidel reveals Adam was a liar and killer who murdered Gwendolyn for power and planned to sacrifice Jared before changing his mind.
events.quote: He murdered his wife Gwendolyn Carthalion in the hopes that it would grant him power to become a Planeswalker .

events.summary: Freed by the vizier's death, Liana is able to act against Ravidel and enters the castle with Ezer.
events.quote: this newly discovered freedom from her oath finally enables Liana to take direct action against Ravidel

events.summary: Narok kills Nikko and Jared annihilates Narok, then crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle; Ezer dies, and the castle explodes from Liana's sorcery.
events.quote: Jared crushes the Black Lotus and summons a Shivan Dragon

events.summary: Jared and Liana share a kiss and he leaves to learn new magic and become a Wayfarer.
events.quote: Jared and Liana share a kiss
